## Experience

- [Software Engineer — Skillablers Technologies Pvt. Ltd.](https://jnana-ai-eng.github.io/#experience): Jun 2025 — May 2026, Bangalore. Built SurveyBot: a real-time conversational survey agent on LiveKit with sub-1-second response latency using Sarvam and Gemini models.

## Projects

- [Swaram — Multi-Tenant Conversational Voice AI Platform](https://jnana-ai-eng.github.io/#projects): Multi-tenant voice AI platform with bring-your-own-carrier SIP telephony, LiveKit Agents runtime with Sarvam & Gemini, pgvector RAG, and Razorpay billing. Tech: FastAPI, LiveKit, Next.js, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Redis, AWS EC2.
- [Data Analysis Agent — LangGraph Multi-Tool Agent](https://jnana-ai-eng.github.io/#projects): Autonomous LangGraph agent profiling uploaded datasets, writing and executing pandas/matplotlib code in isolated E2B sandboxes with inline streaming charts. Tech: LangGraph, Gemini, FastAPI, E2B Sandbox, Docker, Nginx.
- [On-Premise Museum RAG System](https://jnana-ai-eng.github.io/#projects): Self-hosted conversational RAG system for museum visitors asking questions about Bhagavad Gita — 100% in-house with Ollama LLMs and sub-2s response caching. Tech: Ollama, LiteLLM, RAG, FastAPI, Python.
- [E-Paper Digitization & Layout Detection](https://jnana-ai-eng.github.io/#projects): Full-stack newspaper digitization engine using a fine-tuned IndicDLP layout detection model, Hetzner object storage, and interactive article crop viewer. Tech: Computer Vision, IndicDLP, PostgreSQL, React, Python.
